name: WikiLingua: Cross-Lingual Abstractive Summarization Benchmark
description: WikiLingua is a large-scale, multilingual benchmark dataset for cross-lingual abstractive summarization extracted from wikiHow. It pairs comprehensive instructional procedural articles with concise section summaries aligned across 18 languages. Because parallel articles in different languages describe the exact same real-world processes, WikiLingua provides direct cross-lingual supervision across 141,457 unique concepts and approximately 770,000 article-summary pairs.
